name: secondpage
description: Bring your AI work onto one live page to share, comment on, and edit with your team and AI agents. Requires a SecondPage account for adults aged 18 and over.

interface.shortDescription: One live page for your AI work
interface.longDescription: Bring your AI work onto one live page to share, comment on, and edit with your team and AI agents. Publish reports, dashboards, decks, guides, and web files as Pages with a stable URL while available. Revise Pages with version history, read feedback, and add comments. Requires a SecondPage account and an organization you can access. For adults aged 18 and over. Page availability depends on your organization's entitlement.
defaultPrompt: Publish this report as a SecondPage Page.
Revise my Page using its latest feedback.
Find my Pages and summarize their comments.

positive.description: Publish a fresh private sample report. Before the sequence, confirm the reviewer connection is in Directory Review, matching Reviewer credentials. Run positive cases 1 through 5 in this order, in one conversation and agent connection. Retain actual Page, URL and version identifiers in the verification ledger; later cases reuse this exact new Page.
positive.prompt: Create a private SecondPage revenue report from this sample data: Widget 120, Gadget 80, Total 200. Make it a polished one-page report with summary cards, proportional bars and a compact table. Use a restrained palette, system fonts and a responsive layout; one HTML file with inline CSS and no external assets. Label it Sample data, give it a unique run title and return its link.
positive.tools_triggered: create_page; context, publishing guidance, list and read helpers as needed
positive.expected_behavior: Create a new private Page in the authorized reviewer workspace, with actual Page ID, version ID and URL from the successful result retained for later cases. Do not modify an existing Page or switch workspace. The self-contained HTML presents exactly Widget 120, Gadget 80 and Total 200, labeled Sample data, with summary cards, proportional bars and a compact table; no invented currency, trends or extra metrics. The signed-in reviewer can open it. Inspect actual desktop rendering for readable layout, correct values and no horizontal overflow. Helper reads are allowed as needed; do not require gratuitous calls or a fixed HTML line count.

positive.description: Find accessible Pages after case 1 in the same conversation and connection. Use the newly created report as the inclusion fixture. Retain tool results for off-screen completeness and authorization checks.
positive.prompt: List the Pages I can access in our current SecondPage workspace, including the report we just created. Show each title, link and sharing level.
positive.expected_behavior: List authorized Pages in the current reviewer workspace with accurate titles, real slug-based https://<slug>.second.page/ links and visibility labels; organization visibility means workspace-visible. Include the exact new Page once. Follow actual next_cursor values while has_more is true and de-duplicate by Page ID; never describe an incomplete traversal as complete. A single complete batch is valid but does not demonstrate pagination. Do not disclose other-workspace or inaccessible Pages, switch workspaces, change content or call write tools.

positive.description: Add and retrieve actionable feedback on the report from case 1. Run after case 2, in the same conversation and connection. Retain the returned comment ID; case 4 applies this exact saved feedback.
positive.prompt: Add this comment to the report: "Please add 'Total revenue confirmed: 200' beneath the title without changing the figures." Then show me the saved comments on that Page.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the exact Page from case 1. Inspect the baseline and add one top-level agent-authored comment with the exact supplied body and no parent. Retrieve saved comments with filters that include this comment; match the actual comment ID, exact body and parent_comment_id:null. Do not edit the Page or change its version, URL, figures or private sharing. If the exact fixture already exists on replay, report it without duplicating it. Inspect comments before retrying an uncertain write. Missing feedback is a setup failure, never invented success.

positive.description: Revise the existing report from its saved feedback after case 3, in the same conversation and agent connection. Use the current Page version as the update base and retain the successful new version ID.
positive.prompt: Read the saved feedback on this report, then apply it to the existing Page. Keep its link, figures, layout and sharing unchanged.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve the current Page content and actual saved feedback, then update that same Page using the current base version. Add exactly Total revenue confirmed: 200 beneath the title. Return the real existing URL and successful update result. Verify the revised content on the same Page and URL, with a new current version and unchanged figures, layout and private visibility; retain the exact saved comment. Do not create a replacement Page, overwrite a stale version, invent feedback, or change sharing.

positive.description: Share the revised report after case 4, in the same conversation and connection that created it. The reviewer opens the returned SecondPage approval link and approves. Only then send: "I approved the sharing change. Please verify the Page is public." Confirm public visibility with a fresh access read and Anyone with the link in the Page's sharing panel.
positive.prompt: Make this report viewable by anyone with its link. Send me the SecondPage approval link and wait for my approval before confirming it is public.
positive.tools_triggered: read_page_access, set_page_visibility; read_page as needed; read_page_access after human approval
positive.expected_behavior: Read current access and request public visibility once for the exact report. set_page_visibility returns human_approval_required and the real approval_url. Relay the link and wait without claiming public access, bypassing approval or repeating the request. The Page remains private while pending. After approval is completed through SecondPage's approval screen, verify public visibility with a fresh read_page_access result and confirm Anyone with the link in the Page's sharing panel. Keep the latest case 4 content, version, URL and saved comment unchanged. An approval link alone is not success.

negative.description: Draft a report in chat without publishing. Expected: correct total 200 and a short summary/table in chat, with zero SecondPage calls, saved artifacts or substitute Pages.
negative.prompt: Turn Widget 120 and Gadget 80 into a short executive revenue summary with a table here in chat. This is just a draft.

negative.description: Use a different destination. Expected: an editable native Google Doc through the appropriate integration if available, or an honest limitation. Zero SecondPage calls or substitute Pages.
negative.prompt: Create an editable Google Doc called Weekly meeting notes in Google Drive, with Agenda, Decisions and Action items.

negative.description: Generate an image in chat. Expected: the built-in image-generation feature or an honest limitation; zero SecondPage calls, uploads or publication.
negative.prompt: Generate a watercolor sailboat on a calm lake at sunset and show it here.
